title: AAT Accounts Assistant - Practice
description:
Overview

Our client as leading independent firm of Chartered Accountants is looking to recruit an AAT Accounts Assistant with the enthusiasm to join its busy small business accounts and VAT department.

This is a varied role to primarily include bookkeeping and VAT work for clients as well as accounts and Tax Return preparation for a varied portfolio of sole traders, partnerships and small limited companies.

Responsibilities
- Bookkeeping
- VAT Returns
- Accounts preparation
- Personal and Corporation tax computations
- Tax Returns - Self Assessment and Company
- Working to tight deadlines

Experience & Skills
- AAT qualification or proven experience in a similar role
- Excellent communication skills
- Experience gained in an accountancy practice
- Strong bookkeeping and accounts preparation skills
- Working knowledge of preparing Tax Returns
- Good IT skills which must include Excel and Word and either SAGE, QuickBooks or Xero

On offer
- Competitive salary - depending on skills and experience
- Study Support
- Contributory pension and life insurance scheme
- Flexible working including Flexitime system
- Annual leave of 25 days, plus bank holidays (full time equivalent)
- Modern and friendly working environment
- Convenient office location with easily accessible car parking nearby (currently free of charge)
- Structured CPD, training and development programme
- Professional subscriptions reimbursement
- Employee Assistance Programme

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant
Location: Hessle
Salary: £28,000 - £32,000 pro rata
Hours: Part-time

Consortium Professional Recruitment are working on a retained basis with a well-established UK services business to recruit a Finance Assistant. Based in Hessle, this varied, part-time role offers the opportunity to join a supportive team, take ownership of day-to-day finance activities and contribute to improving processes and reporting.

The Opportunity

As a Finance Assistant, you'll play a key role in:
- Managing invoicing, payments and resolving discrepancies.
- Maintaining accurate financial records using Sage, including processing debits, credits and bank reconciliations.
- Updating client databases, ensuring pricing changes and information are recorded accurately.
- Preparing weekly and monthly reports covering sales performance, financial results, budgets and key business information.
- Supporting the team with financial queries and identifying opportunities to improve processes, including the use of AI technology.

About You

We're looking for someone who can bring:
- Previous experience in finance administration, accounts support or a similar role.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Good Excel skills and confidence using financial systems, ideally Sage.
- Excellent organisation, initiative and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
- A friendly, positive personality and the ability to work well within a small team.

You'll also be comfortable with technology and open to learning new ways of working. Previous AI experience isn't needed, just curiosity and a willingness to embrace new ideas.

The Benefits
- Salary of £28,000 to £32,000 pro rata.
- Part-time working hours.
- A welcoming, supportive and close-knit team.
- A varied role with responsibility and the freedom to use your initiative.
- The opportunity to contribute ideas, improve processes and develop your skills.

How to Apply

This Finance Assistant opportunity is being managed on a retained basis by Consortium Professional Recruitment.

If you're looking for a varied, part-time finance role where you can make a real contribution, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with your CV attached.

Consortium Professional Recruitment Ltd are a professional level recruitment consultancy specialising in the delivery of high relevance recruitment services on behalf of our clients across the UK. We regularly receive large responses to our advertising which can make providing individual feedback to every applicant challenging. If you haven't received a reply from us within 14 days of your application, we regret to say your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. We have a policy of retaining your details for future vacancies unless you request otherwise. To learn more about our services, please visit consortiumrecruitment.co.uk

title: Temporary Bookkeeper
description:
Are you a detail-oriented and adaptable Bookkeeper looking for a hands-on role within a small business? Are you used to a stand alone position where you can support the finance function and look at ways to make efficiencies? Are you immediately available and able to work in a temporary contract for a well established business who need additional support to process a backlog of work in the first instance.

Our client, a well-established and growing manufacturer based in the Bridlington area, is seeking a temporary Bookkeeper to join their team and support them with a backlog of accounts work.

They are looking for an enthusiastic individual to take on a crucial role, providing essential financial support and contributing to the smooth operation of the business.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with solid bookkeeping experience, particularly with Sage, who is eager to become an integral part of a hands-on SME.

What the Bookkeeper job involves

You'll play a key role in managing the daily financial operations, ensuring accuracy and efficiency.
- Raising customer invoices and delivery notes on a daily basis.
- Managing the invoice factoring process.
- Daily monitoring of bank accounts and cashflow.
- Payroll administration, collating employee hours each week from a clocking in system and send to payroll.
- Matching invoices and accurately allocating payments within Sage.

This is a varied and fast-paced role that would suit someone who enjoys being at the heart of an operational team, managing multiple financial priorities, and providing excellent administrative support.

Skills required

We're looking for candidates who can demonstrate a practical approach and a willingness to contribute beyond traditional bookkeeping duties. Ideal candidates will have:
- Proven experience with Sage 50 would be beneficial.
- The ability to manage and allocate payments efficiently within Sage.
- Self managed and able to work on their own initiative.
- A high degree of adaptability and flexibility to take on a range of tasks as needed.
- Previous experience in bookkeeping from a small / medium size business.

This role would suit someone who is not afraid to contribute to a busy, hands-on environment.

Other information
- Working hours are initially 10 AM to 4 PM, Monday to Friday.
- On-site car parking available.
- Own transport is essential due to the location.

This vacancy is being advertised through KD Recruitment Limited who are operating as an Employment Agency.

Due to the volume of applications we receive if you have not heard from us within 2 weeks, please assume you have not been short listed for this particular role.

KD Recruitment Limited is committed to a policy of equal opportunities in relation to job applications and we are also committed to protecting your personal data. If you would like to read our privacy policy, please go to our website where you will find all the information you need to know about how we will use and process your personal data.

You can also follow us on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn for up to date jobs and other helpful information.

title: Accounts Payable Controller
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
Working for a global manufacturing company based in East Hull, reporting to the Financial Controller, you will be responsible for managing and controlling the purchase ledger function.
The day-to-day duties will be to manage the purchase invoices from processing through to payment, but we are looking for someone who is open to process improvement and looking at ways to streamline the function. You will also support with month-end journals, intercompany transactions, multi currency transactions, accruals and prepayments, as well as supporting the financial controller with ad hoc projects.

You must have current purchase ledger / accounts payable experience coupled with a strong work ethic, strong IT skills, a positive approach to your work and an openness to development and change.
The company is offering a friendly and supportive team environment, a competitive salary, enhanced pension, 25 days' holiday and an annual bonus.

title: Accounts Receivable Controller
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company

The role is based in the finance team of an expanding global manufacturing company based in East Hull. Reporting to the Financial Controller, you will take full responsibility for the accounts receivable function within the business as well as managing the credit process. You will work closely with the contracts team, customer service department, Quantity Surveyors and sales teams to monitor the credit terms, customer orders, contract payment terms and customer accounts with relation to outstanding invoices.
You will raise the sales invoices and credit notes, set up and manage customer accounts, constantly monitor credit limits, produce the aged debt report and issue commentary, cash flow projections, manage multi currency ledgers and manage various payment and contract terms.

We are looking for someone with current accounts receivable and credit control experience coupled with strong communication skills and the ability to work closely and positively with colleagues.

The company offers a competitive salary plus an annual bonus, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, enhanced pension and future career opportunities.

title: Sales Ledger Clerk
description:
A company who are the largest UK supplier of its products is seeking a Sales Ledger Clerk to join their team. Applicants will be suitably experienced with all aspects of Accounts Receivable as well as Credit Control and related admin. A high degree of accuracy, a proactive work ethic and the ability to manage your workload to changing deadlines are fundamental qualities this client requires.
The Role:
Permanent, full time hours, office based.
Manage all aspects of sales ledger and assist the credit control team.
Credit check new clients and monitor payment history.
Raise invoices (Including duplicates) and verify receipt.
Identify, investigate and solve all account related queries.
Ensure all company financial admin is accurately processed.
The Candidate:
You must possess experience with sales ledger, reconciliations and credit control.
Confidence and accuracy when managing accounts to changing deadlines.
Be assertive and a strong communicator when liaising with suppliers and colleagues to solve account queries.
Ability to make decisions and foresee potential issues by utilising common sense.
Possess a high levels of IT literacy and work ethics.
The Benefits:
Above average holidays
Company bonus scheme
Progression
